Summary: The PC is freezing and files open slowly due to drive health issues. Drive errors are recurring and may be slowing performance.
likely_cause: Failing hard drive causing system instability and slow file access.
Evidence: On Sat 1:34:38 AM, the drive reported 184 read errors with a health warning.
Drive errors occurred on Fri and Thu evenings, showing a pattern of recurring issues.
No resource usage data available to show CPU or memory spikes during freezes.
Recent installs or updates not recorded, ruling out software changes as cause.
Steps: Do not ignore the drive error warnings — back up files immediately.
Stop using the PC until the drive is checked by a professional.
Contact a technician to test or replace the hard drive.
Wait for a hardware failure warning before attempting to use the PC further.
